name: Payout to account not matching verified identity or declared beneficiary
description: Payouts or disbursements are directed to bank accounts, cards or wallets that do not match the verified customer or declared beneficiary.
fp: Customers may legitimately use a joint, family or business account, or a new account after a bank change.

links.name: Payouts to bank accounts in third-party names
links.ctx: Seller payout accounts do not match verified identity.

links.name: Payout to account unrelated to organiser or declared beneficiary
links.ctx: Funds are paid to third-party accounts, prepaid cards or wallets that do not match the organiser's verified identity.
